title: GitHub → Discord Bot
recruiterSummary: A Discord app I developed to keep track of updates across my own, group, and friends’ projects, hosted on Oracle Cloud with a secure HTTPS gateway.
story: A small notification service became a practical exercise in keeping project updates visible while operating a hosted application.
technicalNarrative: The Discord app is hosted on Oracle Cloud with a secure HTTPS gateway; the public repository documents the application and deployment details are being documented.

evidence.label: Deployment note
evidence.value: Public repository · deployment details being documented
